dataset_name: AeroGuard-Net Comprehensive Multi-Regime Flight & Turbulence Dataset

0_takeoff_climb.description: Low speed, high lift, heavy payload, near ground flare

1_clean_cruise_transonic.description: High speed clean cruise, wave drag, L/D optimization

2_approach_ground_effect.description: Landing approach, ground image vortex effect, high-lift flaps

3_severe_turbulence_microburst.description: FAA discrete microbursts (-14 m/s) and continuous Dryden spectra

4_extreme_dynamic_stall.description: Deep stall envelope up to 42 deg AoA with dynamic hysteresis

5_actuator_sensor_degraded.description: Partial SJA failure, 10-25% clogged taps, battery voltage sag

feature_channels.sensors: 32 surface pressure taps (16 upper, 16 lower) with realistic 22Pa noise and dropout masking
